description.value: Day to Day Grocery & Produce is a South Asian wholesale cash-and-carry grocery chain with multiple BC locations, including this Abbotsford store centrally situated on South Fraser Way. The brand specializes in specialty South Asian products that are difficult to find elsewhere, including ayurvedic herbs, exotic spices, premium basmati rice, and fresh produce imported from India. Touring cyclists looking to resupply with pantry staples or explore an unusually broad range of South Asian grocery items will find this a distinctive stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at daytoday.ca is confirmed live and the /locations subpage explicitly lists '31877 South Fraser Way, Abbotsford, BC' as an active Day to Day branch, corroborating the OSM address. The website describes a South Asian wholesale cash-and-carry grocery chain carrying 5,000+ products; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The phone number displayed on the website (604-503-6704) is associated with the Surrey flagship address, not the Abbotsford location, so no confirmed Abbotsford phone is available.
concerns: The phone number shown on the website (604-503-6704) is associated with the Surrey flagship address (7843 128 St), not the Abbotsford branch; no Abbotsford-specific phone number is available.
OSM includes cuisine=indian tag which may suggest prepared food, but the website does not confirm hot or prepared food service at this location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active grocery store with the Abbotsford location confirmed on the brand's own website; a viable resupply stop for touring cyclists.
